description: DISABLED DELIBERATELY. This repository uses Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml),
not Renovate — the one exception in an org that is otherwise all Renovate.
The reason is empirical rather than preference: Renovate has never processed
this repository. The GitHub App is installed org-wide (repository_selection=
all) and this file has always been valid, yet there is no Dependency Dashboard
and not one Renovate PR has ever been opened here. Every repo that Renovate
does process has both. The remaining explanation is per-repo enablement in the
Mend Developer Portal, which is UI-only.
`enabled: false` rather than deleting this file: if the repo is ever switched
on at the Mend level, deleting would leave Renovate running on its DEFAULTS
alongside Dependabot — two bots proposing the same bump, which is exactly the
duplication that left 31 stale PRs across this org. This way it stays off
until somebody removes this line on purpose.
The rules below are kept so they are not rewritten from scratch if that day
comes. To switch over: enable the repo in Mend, delete .github/dependabot.yml,
so this repo inherits org policy instead of the private copy below.

packageRules.description: tf-modules: shared Terraform modules pinned by per-module tag (e.g. cdn-v1.0.0). The 'compatibility' capture group is the module prefix, so Renovate only proposes updates WITHIN the same module's tags (cdn-* never bumps to network-*).
